topics.topic: How good people say their life is
topics.angle: Asked to rate their life from 0 to 10, people in Finland answer near 8; elsewhere the answer is under 4.

dataset.label: Life rating, 0 to 10
dataset.source: World Happiness Report via Our World in Data
dataset.definition: The national average answer to the Cantril ladder question in the Gallup World Poll: imagine a ladder with steps from 0 at the bottom (the worst possible life for you) to 10 at the top (the best possible life for you); on which step do you feel you stand now? Averaged over three years of surveys.

dataset.definition: Food available for human consumption, in kilocalories per person per day, from the FAO food balance sheets. It is the food supply at the retail level, not what people actually eat: food wasted at home is not subtracted.
